marketing_description: Parker Series BVAL 2-way ball valves are engineered to deliver reliable, leak-free performance in hydraulic suction and low-pressure return line applications. Constructed with a lightweight aluminum body, chrome-plated brass ball, and top-grade PTFE ball seats, these valves ensure smooth operation and unrestricted flow to eliminate cavitation. Operating from fully closed to fully open with a simple 90-degree handle rotation, the BVAL series is available in port sizes ranging from 1/4" to 4" with NPT, SAE, BSPP, and ISO 6149 thread options to suit diverse industrial configurations.
bullet_points: Designed specifically for suction line and low-pressure return line applications
Unrestricted bore from 1/4" to 4" eliminates cavitation and flow restriction
Lightweight aluminum body with chrome-plated brass ball and oversized brass stem
Top-grade PTFE ball seats with O-ring seals ensure smooth, leak-free operation
Available with NPT, BSPP, SAE, and ISO 6149 thread options
Rated for maximum working pressures up to 28 Bar (400 PSI)
Wide operating temperature range of -30°C to +100°C (-22°F to +212°F) with standard seals
